evidence.cross_platform_defect: validation/schema.py hashed the RAW bytes of each vendored official nbformat schema against a pinned digest. On a Windows checkout git rewrites LF to CRLF, so all six mismatched, none loaded, and every schema-validated operation raised IPYNB_SCHEMA_ARTIFACT. Identical source passed on Linux. 47 of the 50 visible failures traced to this single cause.
evidence.cross_platform_defect_diagnosis: The pinned SCHEMA_DIGESTS are correct (they match nbformat 5.10.4's own files exactly) and the vendored content is semantically identical to official (json.load equality for all six). All six are byte-identical to official after CRLF->LF. Neither the pins nor the content were wrong; only the hashing was encoding-sensitive.
